Match the approved tactical graphic illustration style with confident painted shapes, crisp dark contour hierarchy, controlled wear, and stable anatomy. Dark black-blue board, even cell spacing, full body never cropped, no text, no labels, no borders, no extra characters.

no duplicated views or missing back view
no character identity, armor layout, proportion, palette, or lighting drift
no weapon, text, labels, borders, cropped anatomy, or extra characters
